cut_en: wide establishing shot, static camera, eye level: from the yard into the open front of the junk shop. Eunju walks in from the left foreground carrying a full sack on her shoulder, eyes lowered to the ground, never turning toward the workshop door at the back left. Old Kwak stands behind the workbench at right. Bright May sun from upper left glints on heaps of scrap metal. Top third of the panel left empty for the title.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: product-like insert shot of the hanging scale needle quivering as a sack lands on it. Bottom: at Eunju's eye level, old Kwak's hand sets the restored can violin down beside the scale; its polished milk-can body gleams and fresh glue shines at the wooden spoon neck joint. Eunju at left foreground hides both gloved hands behind her back, not touching it. Midday sun from upper left.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: close-up, static camera, eye level on Eunju's face, mouth closed, eyebrows still, eyes fixed down on the can violin; a long silent beat, quiet composition. Bottom: over-the-shoulder from behind Eunju, old Kwak finally reads the scale needle, holding the pencil he took from behind his ear, face calm. Bright midday light from upper left.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot, eye level, old Kwak at right points with his chin toward an empty apple crate by the door, sunlight from upper left. Bottom: flashback, the same junk shop at night under one yellow bulb, surrounded by navy darkness; Manseok seen from behind sits hunched on the apple crate, while old Kwak's hand works a glue brush on the workbench. Neither speaks.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, the cotton work gloves just taken off, bare hands

cut_en: extreme close-up, side view: Eunju's bare fingertip, gloves just pulled off, lightly taps the polished milk-can body of the can violin lying beside the scale. Her face at the top edge, lips slightly parted, breath held. Soft golden light rings spread round from the can body, the same ring as the very first time. Midday light from upper left.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, the cotton work gloves just taken off, bare hands

cut_en: high angle looking down: Eunju's bare palms held together, one plain fictional paper bill with no real currency design and a few coins on them and the can violin set on top. She supports it with both hands. In the upper right background old Kwak has already turned away, sliding his pencil back behind his ear. Bright May sun from upper left.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: static camera, eye level, doenjang stew bubbling on the kerosene stove; Eunju sets the can violin openly in the middle of the floor beside the low table, Dongmin at right with a spoon in his mouth looks from his sister to the can. Bottom: the door opens, Manseok freezes halfway out of his rubber boots, eyes on the can; in the foreground his right hand grips the air once, then opens. Orange dusk light from the left window.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: full shot, static camera, eye level, facing the low table: the three sit and eat in silence, Manseok in the middle lifting his first spoonful without looking at the can violin still lying on the floor, Eunju at left, Dongmin at right nodding off over his empty bowl, spoon slipping from his hand. Large empty space at the top. Warm dusk light and the blue stove flame.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: extreme close-up, eye level: in the foreground Manseok's long fingers wrap the wooden spoon neck of the can violin; the fingertips move by themselves, covering and uncovering invisible holes like playing a clarinet, not pressing strings. Behind, out of focus, Eunju sits with knees together watching the fingers, tilting her head slightly to the left. A single bulb overhead casts a warm yellow circle, corners in navy shade.

outfit.manseok: a 1970s Korean theater show band uniform: a white jacket with wide peaked lapels, a white shirt, a black bow tie, dark flared trousers, no cap

cut_en: flashback in sepia tones, long shot moving from the front of a 1970s city theater show stage toward the band seats at the back: a glittering curtain and a singer's silhouette in front, behind them in the band seats a younger Manseok, in his mid-20s, no work cap in this flashback, plays the clarinet, long fingers covering and opening the holes. Stage spotlights backlight the scene. Only from the clarinet do faint wine-colored light rings spread, far away.

char_text.manseok: Manseok in his mid-20s, Korean man, 170cm, slim with an upright posture, long face, clean-shaven, thick black hair neatly combed back with pomade (no cap, no gray), long fingers

cut_en: medium shot, eye level: Manseok sits with the can violin on his knees and looks down at it for a long time; his thumb slowly strokes the rim of the can. Lips pressed shut for a half-beat pause before speaking. The bulb above lights the top of his cap and leaves his eyes in soft shade.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: close-up, frontal: Eunju's face, breath held, eyes wide and unblinking; her hand rises without thinking to her bare neck where a pendant used to hang. The background falls away into flat navy shade, quiet composition, as if every sound in the room has dropped out. Warm bulb light from above.

outfit.manseok: a 1970s Korean theater show band uniform: a white jacket with wide peaked lapels, a white shirt, a black bow tie, dark flared trousers, no cap

cut_en: flashback in sepia tones, over-the-shoulder from behind the mother: after rehearsal in the band seats, a young woman stands in front of a younger Manseok, in his mid-20s, no work cap in this flashback. She is a backlit silhouette seen only from behind, her face never visible, stage lights pouring past her. Seated Manseok holds his clarinet and looks up at her, slightly surprised.

char_text.manseok: Manseok in his mid-20s, Korean man, 170cm, slim with an upright posture, long face, clean-shaven, thick black hair neatly combed back with pomade (no cap, no gray), long fingers

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: bust shot, eye level: Manseok at right, the corner of his mouth moving up just a little, eyes on the can violin in his lap rather than on his daughter; Eunju at left looks at him sideways with lips slightly open. Warm bulb light from above, navy shade at the edges.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high angle insert, Manseok's long fingers tap an empty rice bowl on the low table with a spoon. Bottom: extreme close-up, side view, Eunju's left ear and profile with wisps of hair at her temple; her lips silently mouth his words, then she gives a very small nod. Warm bulb light from above.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot, eye level, Manseok, voice dropping, takes a yellowed folded paper from the inner pocket of his field jacket, eyes lowered. Bottom: product-like insert shot of the worn pawn ticket, the fold lines rubbed so the print is half gone, unreadable blank columns suggesting text. Warm bulb light from above.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: medium shot, eye level: Manseok at right holds the pawn ticket on his knee, eyes on the floor, speaking low. Eunju at left keeps her mouth shut, her hands tightening around her drawn-up knees. Single bulb above, warm yellow circle, navy corners.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot, Manseok folds the pawn ticket and tucks it away. Bottom: high angle looking down into the open wooden radio box he quietly brought from the side room: the mother's radio, and beside it a silver tuning fork with a tangled thin chain; his long fingers untangle the knots one by one. At the top edge Eunju's lips part and close again.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: extreme close-up, eye level: Manseok's long fingers passing the thin chain around the back of Eunju's neck and fastening it over the collar of her navy jacket, her face cut off at the top edge of the frame. Bottom: close-up, eye level: the silver tuning fork now rests on her jacket collar; her shoulder flinches at the cold metal and she flicks the fork with a fingernail. The room is desaturated and a soft silver-white band of light leaves the fork and circles the room once, curving along the panel edges.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel, eye level: Eunju at left foreground rests the can violin under her chin, bow raised, eyes on her father. Manseok at right background stays seated and does not get up, that is the whole point of the panel. As the bow touches the strings, a small golden ring falls softly around the can only. Lower part: his long fingers on his knee move again, covering and opening. Warm bulb light.

close-up, side view: Manseok's profile half in shadow under the bulb, the plywood wall of the side room at left. He lets out a short breath through his nose; the corners of his mouth do not move, impossible to tell a laugh from a sigh. Warm light from above, navy shade on the far side of his face.

tall panel, extreme long shot, eye level, from the hilltop toward the south: in the blue-gray dawn Eunju sits small in the foreground, a notebook open on her knees with unreadable blank columns suggesting text, flicking the tuning fork against her knee. Far away on the dyke road two truck headlights. The surroundings are desaturated; a silver-white ring spreads from the fork while a low pale blue wave band rolls up along the ground from the road; the pebbles near her tremble.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: bust shot, side view, Eunju mutters to herself, head tilted to the left, the corners of her mouth still, flat blue-gray dawn light. Bottom: high angle insert of the open notebook on her knee and a pencil, a short line of handwriting, unreadable blank columns suggesting text.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating (just back from sorting scrap), no boots

cut_en: wide establishing shot from the door into the workshop: Seonyoung, Mija, Deoksu and Dongmin bend over their instruments around the workbench, Deoksu chewing scorched-rice crackers. In the foreground Eunju sets her notebook down on the workbench, standing very straight. Afternoon sun slants in from the left window, sawdust floating in the beams.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating (just back from sorting scrap), no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: close-up, Mija at left with her mouth hanging open, Deoksu at right frozen with a cracker between his teeth. Bottom: medium shot, Eunju at left fidgets her gloved fingertips; Seonyoung, unfolding staff paper, drops her pencil and bends to pick it up while her round glasses slide down her nose, flustered, eyebrows high, smiling widely. Afternoon light from the left.

medium shot, eye level: Deoksu in the center hugs the oil-drum cello and draws the bow long and low, eyes droopy and calm. Mija at right, arms folded, nods. In the left foreground Seonyoung pushes up her glasses and writes one word at the top of the staff paper, unreadable blank columns suggesting text. Afternoon light from the left window, sawdust in the air.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees; in the top frame at the scrap heap plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating and rubber boots, in the bottom frame in the workshop bare hands and worn canvas sneakers

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: morning at the scrap heap at the foot of the big hill, high angle on Eunju's gloved hands and rubber boots, picking out a copper pipe and an aluminum pot from the junk, low sun from the east. Bottom: in the workshop, medium shot, Eunju taps the pipe and then the pot, head tilted to the left, listening. Sunlight from the workshop window.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: extreme close-up of Eunju's fingers plucking the strings of the can violin. Bottom: medium shot, Dongmin at right beats the X-ray film drum a half beat early, grinning with the gap in his front teeth; Eunju at left turns to look at him, the corners of her mouth rising just slightly, lips closed. Daylight from the window.

outfit.mija: a loose-fitting red cotton-knit tracksuit top with a single contrasting stripe down each sleeve, zip front, no logo, dark trousers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: low angle looking up, Mija against the noon sky in rubber boots, waving a torn white plastic sheet in the wind in her gloved hand. Bottom: full shot, Mija blows breath without a note into the drainpipe trumpet, then throws her arms wide, chin up; behind her the kids in white cotton work gloves and rubber boots laugh and Seonyoung scribbles in the corner of her staff paper, unreadable blank columns suggesting text. Strong overhead sun, short shadows.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: wide shot of the soup tent at dusk, grandma Sunrye strikes the iron soup pot three times with her ladle, islanders gather; she plops the ladle into Deoksu's held-out hands. Bottom: in the workshop under a bulb, Deoksu strikes the rim of the oil-drum cello with the borrowed ladle in the background; in the foreground the staff paper with four sections, unreadable blank columns suggesting text, the last one empty, and Eunju's eyes at the top edge resting on that blank.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: extreme close-up, side view, in the dark side room Eunju sits on the blanket, head tilted left, ear pressed to her mother's old transistor radio; the static fades and four thin pale violet rings rise from the speaker. Bottom: medium shot, she rests the can violin under her chin and draws the bow very gently; a thin golden band runs alongside the violet band. Only a strip of navy night light from the small window.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: medium shot, eye level: Eunju plays the can violin, eyes half closed; four golden rings spread one after another from the can. In the right background Seonyoung, who was writing on staff paper with unreadable blank columns suggesting text, stops her pencil mid-stroke and looks up. The surroundings desaturated; daylight from the left window.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: extreme close-up of Seonyoung's hands wiping her round glasses on the hem of her blouse, slowly, for a long time; a quiet wordless beat. Bottom: bust shot, she puts the glasses back on, the tip of her nose a little red, speaking softly; Mija and Deoksu in the background glance at her sideways. Daylight from the left.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high angle insert of the staff paper, the formerly blank section now filled with a word and the last section with a short line, unreadable blank columns suggesting text; Seonyoung's finger taps each section in turn, counting. Bottom: medium shot, Dongmin holds up six fingers, staring at them, head tilted, puzzled. Daylight.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: point-of-view shot from inside the dim workshop toward the door gap, a vertical strip of daylight with six pairs of children's eyes stacked one above another. Bottom: Mija opens the door and the island kids tumble in and stop; she folds her arms, the kids flinch back, the smallest boy hides behind the girl with the red headband; Mija lifts her chin, gruff. The twin in blue and the twin in orange stand side by side.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating for sorting the scrap cans, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high angle looking down, the kids knock their shoes at the threshold while old Kwak silently empties a sack of tin cans onto the floor, cans rolling outward. Bottom: extreme close-up, Eunju's gloved hand taps the cans one by one, the hand drawn three times in sequence across the frame. Daylight from the window.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating for sorting the scrap cans, no boots

cut_en: extreme close-up, side view: Eunju's gloved hand stops on one can; her left ear at the top edge of the panel leans toward it. The surroundings are desaturated and only from that can a clear, round pale blue ring spreads into the air. Daylight from the left window.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating for sorting the scrap cans, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot, Eunju at left holds out the chosen can, old Kwak at right takes it in his thick hand. Bottom: high angle on the workbench, Kwak's bent fingers fit a wooden spoon neck onto the can; beside it a coil of piano wire pulled from the drawer, and he picks out only the thin wire to wind on the peg. Daylight.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames, introduction shots. Top: the next day two new can violins lie on the workbench; Bonggu receives the second one in both hands and plucks a string, mischievous eyes going wide. Bottom: Yeongran tucks the third can violin under her chin, pigtails falling forward, her little mouth pressed firm. Daylight from the left.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames, introduction shots. Top: the twin in blue and the twin in orange face each other, each holding a pot lid, and clash them; both flinch in exactly the same way. Bottom: high angle, Suni and Seoki pour water into empty glass bottles to slightly different levels; Eunju taps a bottle and tilts her head left, listening, the water lines a sip apart. Daylight.

outfit.deoksu: a stretched, slightly yellowed thin white cotton-knit sleeveless undershirt (a Korean 'running shirt', not an athletic tank top) and shorts
outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel, wide establishing shot: the workshop packed with ten children and their instruments, the can violins, oil-drum cello, drainpipe trumpet, X-ray film drum, pot lid cymbals and bottle xylophone. In the foreground Suni and Seoki tap the bottles; Dongmin cups his hands around his mouth and shouts. Daylight from the left window.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: insert of the title on top of the staff paper, unreadable blank columns suggesting text. Bottom: wide shot, Seonyoung lifts a spoon-handle baton and ten children play together for the first full run-through, clumsy but earnest. No desaturation: only tiny dots of light hover right at the instruments, orange at the cello, gold at the can violin, red at the drum, teal at the trumpet. Dusk at the window, bulb inside.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot, the music has died down, every child's eyes turn to Eunju at left; Seonyoung at right speaks brightly, baton raised. Bottom: extreme close-up, side view, the tip of Eunju's bow stopped in the air just above the strings of the can violin. Bulb light, dusk outside the window.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames, flashback to the preliminary round. Top: from the stage looking at a packed audience laughing, faces blurred in washed-out white stage light, the whole frame drained to near gray, no color glow. Bottom: product-like insert of a vertical newspaper column with a short headline, unreadable blank columns suggesting text.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: extreme close-up, Eunju's knuckles gone white around the bow, an empty silent background. Bottom: medium shot, Dongmin at left quietly sets his spoon drumsticks down; Seonyoung adjusts her glasses once, twice, and lays the baton on the workbench where its wooden handle rolls. Bulb light.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: bust shot, eye level: Seonyoung starts to smile and gives up halfway, the corners of her mouth stalling, eyebrows drooping behind her round glasses, hands clasped. Eunju in the left foreground, back three-quarter, still holding the bow, looks at her. Warm bulb light from above.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high angle bust shot, Seonyoung looks down at something on the workbench, glasses catching the bulb light. Bottom: high angle looking down into her open, empty violin case on the workbench, holding only sheet music with unreadable blank columns suggesting text and colorful wrapped candies.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: close-up, frontal, Eunju lifts her face, her stiff shoulders sinking a little as a breath leaves her. Bottom: medium shot, Seonyoung crouches in front of Eunju so their eyes are level, speaking low and plainly; Eunju pauses half a beat, then nods. Warm bulb light.

medium shot, low angle: Mija springs to her feet, fists clenched, bandage across her nose, shouting; beside her Dongmin shoots his hand straight up in the air, mouth wide open, eager. The other kids look up at them from their instruments. Warm bulb light from above, dusk window behind.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot, Deoksu at left speaks slowly, droopy-eyed; Seonyoung at right waves both hands frantically, her glasses sliding to the tip of her nose. Bottom: extreme close-up, after a breath her hand closes firmly around the spoon-handle baton on the workbench. Bulb light.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: full shot from the workbench toward the door, Manseok stands in the doorway backlit by the last dusk light, come to pick up Dongmin; his eyes go to the empty violin case, then to Seonyoung. Bottom: flashback insert, inside a pawnshop under yellowish fluorescent light, two people's shoulders brushing past each other at the counter.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot, Seonyoung at left drops her pencil again, fixes her glasses and bows her head quickly; Manseok at right nods once. Bottom: Manseok drags an apple crate from the doorway and sits on it while Seonyoung raises the baton and the children start again; the window turns dark and the bulb glows. He does not get up.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high angle, in a corner of the empty workshop reached only by distant bulb light, Mija alone writes on an empty milk can with a thick marker, with unreadable blank strokes suggesting text, mouth pressed tight. Bottom: high angle looking down into the can, a single coin falling from her fingers onto the bottom; the side of the can bears hand-written letters, unreadable blank columns suggesting text.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high angle, from the white fluorescent tubes down to the rows of desks; Mr. Choi hunches almost flat over his desk pressing hard with a ballpoint pen; a desk fan turns its head and lifts the corners of papers; on the wall a plain wall poster with only unreadable blank lines suggesting a slogan, no emblem, no rings, no mascot. Bottom: extreme close-up of the report cover, a drop of sweat landing on one word and blurring the ink, unreadable blank columns suggesting text.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high angle insert of the report body text, three short paragraphs, unreadable blank columns suggesting text; at the edge a handkerchief dabs the forehead, the paper, the forehead again. Bottom: side view at the section chief's desk, the chief at right holds the report and looks over his glasses; Mr. Choi at left stands at attention. Fluorescent light from above.

bust shot, side view: Mr. Choi at left folds and unfolds his damp handkerchief, folds and unfolds it again, the motion drawn twice; his eyes rest on the corner of the chief's desk, sweat on his brow. The section chief at right background, out of focus. Flat fluorescent light from above.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: bust shot, side view, the section chief at right asks a question; Mr. Choi at left answers only by wiping his forehead with the already soaked handkerchief. Bottom: a brief memory insert from earlier on the island (not the 1950s), low angle insert of shiny leather shoe tips sinking into mud in front of a soup tent, overcast daylight.

flashback in faded colors, close-up, high angle: under a leaking tin roof of a 1950s shanty, only the small bare feet of a crouching little child are visible, toes curled on the dirt floor; gray rain light; raindrops drumming on the tin. No face shown.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: close-up, eye level, back in the office, the white fluorescent light returns; Mr. Choi's face wet with sweat, his eyes behind thick horn-rimmed glasses looking straight at the chief. Bottom: high angle insert, after a long sigh the chief's approval stamp comes down on the document.

tall panel, wide shot from the yard toward the soup tent: Mr. Choi pins an official notice, unreadable blank columns suggesting text, to the tent post with thumbtacks, then turns to face the gathering islanders, Mija and her mother, the island kids, and grandma Sunrye in her floral apron. He wipes his forehead between sentences. July noon sun overhead, short shadows.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: bust shot, eye level, Mr. Choi goes on, handkerchief clutched in his hand, glasses glinting in the noon sun. Bottom: two-shot, Mija's mother at left turns to look at Mija; Mija at right looks up at her mother and presses her lips tightly together. Overhead July sun.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high angle insert, grandma Sunrye's ladle strikes the iron soup pot as the murmuring dies down; everyone turns. Bottom: medium shot, Sunrye at right, ladle in hand, speaks flatly; Mr. Choi at left stands awkwardly half-bowed, clutching his handkerchief. Steam from the pot, noon light filtered through the tent cloth.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: wide shot, a single bulb over the workbench makes a small circle of light in navy darkness; Eunju wipes the can violin with a rag, Dongmin sleeps open-mouthed on a scrap sack, a borrowed white dress hangs on a nail; Kwak climbs down the attic ladder holding a cloth bundle, dust falling. Bottom: high angle, the cloth unwrapped on the workbench, a honey-colored violin glowing softly; his bent ring and little fingers stroke its back; behind, Eunju's hand stops.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: medium shot, eye level: Eunju at left, mouth closed, looks at the violin; old Kwak at right, upright, holds it out to her. She receives it with both hands, her hands lifting slightly at how light it is. Warm bulb light from above, navy darkness around.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: very tall panel, low angle: Eunju at the bottom rests the honey-colored violin under her chin, eyes widening a little, and draws the bow. In the desaturated workshop a smooth, broad band of cool blue light flows like a river up the walls and across the ceiling; the view climbs from her to the rafters following the sound. Sawdust lifts slowly from the shelves into the bulb light and the blue band.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot, a silent beat; Eunju lays the violin back down on the cloth and pushes it toward old Kwak with both hands. Bottom: she picks up the can violin from the workbench; Kwak's thick white eyebrows rise. Warm bulb light from above, navy darkness around.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: extreme close-up, side view: Eunju's fingertip taps the body of the can violin. The surroundings are desaturated and only from the can a round golden ring spreads softly into the air, the same ring as the very first time. Her eyes at the top edge are steady. Warm bulb light from above.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: bust shot, Eunju holds the can violin against her chest and speaks calmly, only the corners of her mouth moving a little. Bottom: close-up, static camera, old Kwak's face held for a long silent moment under the humming bulb; in the last corner his shoulders begin to shake.

outfit.eunju: a faded light-blue short-sleeved cotton shirt, worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: very tall panel, the camera pulls back to show the whole workshop: old Kwak throws his head back and laughs from the belly for the first time; the cans on the shelves rattle along, the reading glasses on his forehead slide down to his nose. Eunju at left watches, lips closed, only the corners of her mouth lifted, no open smile. At the bottom Dongmin bolts upright on the scrap sack, rubbing his eyes.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: bust shot, old Kwak, still unable to stop laughing, wipes his eyes with the corner of his apron. Bottom: high angle looking down at the workbench under the single bulb: the honey-colored violin wrapped loosely in its cloth lies side by side with the can violin, not taken back up the ladder.

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: low angle from the foot of the wide stone steps looking up at the concrete facade and tall glass doors, the plaza glaring white under the overhead noon sun. Bottom: an old charter bus stopping on the plaza, a handwritten paper sign with unreadable blank strokes suggesting text inside the windshield, island villagers in ironed shirts, old blouses and sneakers stepping down, one looking at his shoe tips, one touching her collar, short shadows

medium shot, eye level: grandma Sunrye on the left pointing at the ground with her folded apron, mouth wide open shouting, island villagers scrambling into a single line behind her, passers-by in business suits glancing over. Inset frame lower right: close-up of Manseok on the bus step, his long fingers pulling the field-jacket collar closed again and again, eyes lifted toward the glass doors. Harsh noon light from above

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: Eunju seen frontally in the corridor mirror under white fluorescent tubes, pushing up a sleeve that slides back over her hand, fingers touching the tuning-fork pendant; far behind, out of focus, children tying red neckerchiefs on each other. Bottom: back view of Eunju hugging her tin-can violin, head tilted left, walking toward the dark end of the corridor while a very faint blue band seeps out of the wall

medium shot, eye level in the dim stage wing: old Kwak on a folding chair at left tuning a tin-can violin on his knee, glasses on his nose; behind him Deoksu, Mija and Dongmin in a line hugging their scrap instruments; Seonyoung gripping the baton with both hands, lips moving silently; Eunju in the right foreground pressing her eye to the curtain gap. A blade of cold white stage light and a faint thin blue band leak through the gap

point-of-view shot from Eunju through the curtain gap, dark curtain edges framing the view: a forest of dozens of bows striking down at once like rain in perfect unison, players in black concert clothes under a narrow cold white spotlight from above, the hall dark; Taejun in the concertmaster seat at front center, his bow flashing up and down like lightning. Thin straight translucent blue lines trail from every bow

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: extreme close-up of Taejun's left fingertips pressing the strings of his violin, trembling very slightly, the blue light bands drifting away to the frame edges so only the fingertips remain. Bottom: close-up side view of Eunju at the dark curtain gap, expressionless, tilting her head a little further to the left, cold white light across her eye

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: Eunju stepping back from the curtain as uniformed young players in black file past with shiny instrument cases, a few glancing sideways at the scrap instruments. Bottom: medium two-shot, Taejun on the right stopping in front of Eunju, looking down at the tin-can violin in her arms; small inset of the worn, faded spot on its E string; Eunju answering flatly, mouth still. Dim warm work lamp above

product-like insert shot, high angle looking down into the open drawer of old Kwak's wooden workbench in his workshop: a faded paper envelope for violin strings lying open and empty among small tools and wood shavings, lit by a single bare incandescent bulb from above, warm brown shadows, quiet composition, empty negative space

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: Taejun standing alone in a dark corner of the wing, hand gripping his violin case handle, eyes fixed on the stage, Eunju glancing back at him. Bottom: back view from the darkness of the wing, Seonyoung nodding to the children, the children hugging their scrap instruments walking out into the bright warm stage light, Eunju last in line

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: wide establishing shot from the back of the dark hall, the stage lights coming on, warm amber spotlight over the wooden stage where the island children stand with their scrap instruments, Eunju in the center, Seonyoung facing them. Bottom: a strip of six small insert frames, one instrument each: an oil drum, a drainpipe, a paint can, two pot lids, six empty bottles, three milk-can violins

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high angle over the audience, men in neckties, women with folding fans, students and the judges' table, laughter spreading across the rows like a wave, the whole frame drained of color toward gray, no glowing light. Bottom: two small frames side by side: grandma Sunrye in a back row pressing her lips tight; Manseok in the middle of the hall, his hand on his knee clenching into a fist

tall panel split into three frames. Top: Eunju center stage, violin under her chin, bow frozen a hand-span above the strings, arm heavy, lips pressed. Middle: point-of-view shot from Eunju, the audience beyond the lights blown out to white, a vertical-column newspaper clipping flickering over it with unreadable blank columns suggesting text. Bottom: extreme close-up of the wooden baton tip trembling in the air. Drained, desaturated colors

extreme close-up: Dongmin's small fingertip tapping twice, very softly, on the X-ray film skin of his drum, the pale shadow of bones visible in the film, warm stage light from above; two tiny soft red rings spread out from the touch point, everything else quiet and dim

flashback inserts, panel split horizontally into two frames, warm navy night light. Top: extreme close-up of a girl's knuckles knocking twice on a thin plywood wall inside a tiny shack room. Bottom: the same spot on the same wall, a grown woman's hand in a faded floral sleeve knocking twice, only the hand visible, never the face

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: close-up of Eunju's face straight on, breath held then released, not looking back, her left hand closing once around the tuning-fork pendant and letting go, eyes steady. Bottom: her shoulders dropping as the bow settles onto the strings; in the foreground Seonyoung lifts the baton with a spoon-handle grip, its tip now perfectly still. Warm amber spotlight from above

close-up, low angle: Deoksu drawing a long slow bow stroke across the oil-drum cello, his lips pressed together in concentration, warm amber spotlight from above; a wide low soft orange wave of light rolls out of the drum body, the rest of the frame beginning to fade toward muted colors

long shot, camera at stage-floor height gliding toward the audience: a low orange light wave crawling along the wooden floor and into the rows, faces in the front rows going quiet first, row after row; far in the back left corner Mr. Choi in a gray suit frozen in his seat, handkerchief clutched, eyes wide with recognition

long shot, double-exposure: the blurred stage lights dissolve into a translucent blue-gray dawn, headlights of a first truck coming over the embankment road, and on the small hilltop the tiny figure of Eunju in her everyday navy jacket hugging her knees, listening; faintly through it, Eunju on stage in her white dress. A soft orange band breaks once like a cough, then continues

extreme close-up: Eunju's fingertips plucking the strings of the tin-can violin, one round soft pluck and one sharp bright pluck, small golden dots of light popping off the strings, a faint orange band still lingering low behind, the surroundings muted, warm spotlight from above

medium shot, eye level: Bonggu and Yeongran plucking their tin-can violins at left, Dongmin in the center striking his X-ray-film drum a half beat early, red rings bursting from the drumhead, the twins at right clashing pot lids; behind them a translucent hazy beige overlay of the island morning, gloved hands rummaging a scrap heap and a hanging scale needle quivering; gold and orange glows faint

close-up, high angle in the dark third row of the audience: a small child's hand patting its own knee in rhythm, a mother's hand reaching over to hold it, then gently letting go; only the hands and knees in frame, soft spill of warm stage light from the right

close-up, side view: Mija blowing toneless breath into the funnel bell of her drainpipe trumpet, cheeks puffed round, soft teal waves of light flowing out; behind her a translucent overlay of the July midday wind over the top of the trash hill, torn white plastic sheets flapping like flags under a hazy sky, while the faint orange, gold and red bands from before still linger low across the stage, four colors now

tall long shot, low angle tilting upward: Suni and Seoki tapping water-filled bottles at left, three tin-can violins trembling their bows, pot lids swishing; the children laughing as they play, except Eunju in the middle who does not laugh, head tilted toward the wind; four translucent bands of orange, gold, red and teal swirl up from the stage toward the ceiling

medium shot, eye level in the back rows: island villagers in their best clothes breaking into warm, soft-eyed smiles; grandma Sunrye in the center slapping her own knee and nudging her neighbor's arm, grinning toward the stage, dim navy audience light with warm spill from the stage

outfit.sunrye: baggy elastic-waist Korean work trousers (momppe) in a small floral print, wide in the leg and gathered at the ankles, and a flower-pattern apron

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: close-up of Deoksu striking the rim of the oil drum three times with a ladle; behind, a translucent overlay in orange dusk light of grandma Sunrye in her work clothes striking a big soup pot with a ladle at her tent while villagers gather; four faint color bands linger. Bottom: the children lowering their instruments, the spotlight narrowing until only Eunju stands in a small circle of light

medium shot, eye level: Eunju alone in a narrow warm spotlight, the rest of the stage in darkness, her bow just touching the strings, eyes half lowered; a single thin soft golden ring of light spreads small and delicate from the tin-can violin, no other colors, quiet composition, empty negative space

extreme close-up, high angle in the dark middle of the audience: Manseok's long thin fingers on his knee moving as if covering and uncovering the holes of an invisible clarinet, his other hand gripping the seat armrest, the olive sleeve edge visible, faint warm spill from the stage

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: close-up of Eunju on stage closing her eyes, face calm. Bottom: flashback, close on the workbench, a blurred sepia vision of a small 1970s radio repair shop, shelves crowded with radios, a young woman's fingers flicking a small silver tuning fork on the workbench, only her hands visible, never the face; soft silver-white rings spread from the fork

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: extreme close-up of Eunju's left hand sliding high up the neck of the tin-can violin, a thin golden glow rising. Bottom: slow-motion extreme close-up, the thin E string snapping and curling up into a spiral, flicking past her hand without touching it, the golden light going out at once

wide shot, static camera, eye level from the house: the whole stage frozen, the children motionless with their instruments, Eunju in the center holding the violin, no light bands at all, the snapped string curled at the scroll, every bow and mallet stopped mid-air, muted colors, quiet composition, empty negative space

long shot from the middle of the audience: Manseok in the foreground half rising from his seat, the only upper body sticking up among the seated crowd, people murmuring and turning their heads; far on the stage Eunju standing frozen, gripping the violin with the broken string, warm spotlight on her

medium shot, eye level from behind the stage edge: Seonyoung holding the baton still in the air with her right hand, turning toward Deoksu and Mija, her open left hand drawing one long slow horizontal line through the air, her face firm behind round glasses; Deoksu and Mija watching her, instruments ready

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: Deoksu laying his bow flat on the oil drum and Mija blowing into the drainpipe trumpet, only two long unending bands of orange and teal stretching across the frame, a translucent sunset ridge of the trash hill behind with one plastic sheet flying far on the wind. Bottom: tilted handheld-style back view of Eunju seen at a distance, running into the dark wing, the long skirt of her white dress, below the knee, swaying behind her as she runs

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: behind the dark curtain Taejun has already opened his violin case, close on his hands lifting the lid, Eunju rushing in from the left. Bottom: extreme close-up of a small coiled new violin string passing from Taejun's fingers into Eunju's hand without any pause, a line of warm stage light slipping through the curtain

tall panel split into three quick frames, high angle extreme close-ups of old Kwak's hands: unwinding the broken string from the tin-can violin; his bent ring and little fingers moving surprisingly fast, threading the new string over the fork bridge; winding the wooden peg, while Eunju breathes hard beside him, stage light flickering through the curtain gap. Single yellow work lamp above

close-up, eye level: Eunju lifting the small silver tuning fork from her neck and striking it on her knee, her eyes on Kwak's hands; thin soft silver-white rings rising from the fork into the darkness behind the curtain, one yellow circle of a work lamp above

tall panel split into four frames, two by two. Top left: close-up of sweat beading on Deoksu's forehead, his trembling arm holding the bow flat, an orange band. Top right: Mija's apple-red puffed cheeks taking a quick breath, a teal band. Bottom left: Mr. Choi in the back corner puffing his own cheeks, wiping his forehead with a handkerchief. Bottom right: Manseok half standing, staring toward the dark wing

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: extreme close-up of old Kwak's bent fingers plucking the new string and turning the wooden peg half a turn, then a quarter turn. Bottom: everything else falls dark and quiet, two soft silver-white rings wobbling against each other, then settling and merging into one still ring

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: old Kwak, face unchanged, pressing the repaired tin-can violin into Eunju's hands while Taejun snaps his case shut without looking at her. Bottom: Eunju in the foreground turning toward the bright stage light, the violin in her arms; behind, Taejun walking down the side steps into the dark audience to the end seat of the front row

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: bust shot, Eunju back at center stage looking at Seonyoung, Seonyoung nodding once. Bottom: close on Seonyoung's left hand closing into a fist, the light bands vanishing, a still half beat, quiet composition, empty negative space, warm amber spotlight

tall panel split into six small frames cut on the beat: Deoksu's bow on the oil drum; Bonggu and Yeongran's tin cans; Mija's puffed cheeks; Suni and Seoki tapping bottles; Deoksu striking the drum rim with a ladle between strokes; Dongmin's spoon drumsticks hitting the drum. Orange, teal and red bands pile up frame by frame, and the colors grow fuller and more saturated toward the bottom

close-up, low angle: Eunju playing high on the new E string, bow arm lifted, lips closed with only the corners softening slightly; a bright golden glow floats above all the other bands, the brightest light in the frame; in the darkness above her head a translucent first star appears in a night sky. Full natural saturation, colors no longer muted

wide establishing shot from the back of the hall, static camera: for the first time the whole frame is filled with color, nothing desaturated; translucent bands of orange, teal and red flood the air from the stage over the audience, a brilliant gold ribbon brightest on top; the entire audience sits utterly still, arms that were folded now loose; Manseok in the middle rows and Taejun at the front row end seen from behind

outfit.manseok: a worn, faded plain solid olive-drab 1980s Korean army field jacket (no camouflage pattern, no patches, no insignia, no name tape), a cotton towel around the neck, worn dark work trousers, rubber boots

cut_en: tall montage split into three frames, translucent like a vision, deep navy night. Top: stars above the dark flat-topped trash hill. Middle: small yellow lit windows of the shack village. Bottom: high angle, the back of Manseok climbing the small hill alone at night, a single flashlight circle ahead of him. Gold, orange, teal and red light ribbons flow along the frame borders, full color

medium shot, side view: Eunju drawing the final note with a long, very long bow stroke all the way to the tip, eyes lowered, body still; from the bow tip a single round golden ring of light begins to lift into the air, warm spotlight from above, full natural color

tall shot looking straight up toward the dark ceiling of the concert hall: a single round golden ring of light rising slowly between the ceiling lighting rigs, hovering there, then fading away; only the warm rim of the stage spotlight at the very bottom of the frame, the rest dark and empty, quiet composition, empty negative space

panel split horizontally into two identical frames, static camera, eye level: Eunju standing center stage facing us, violin under her chin and bow still raised, absolutely still in the warm spotlight; in the second frame only her eyes blink once. Dark silent hall, quiet composition, empty negative space

full shot, low angle from the front row: Taejun standing up alone at the end seat in his black concert clothes, posture straight, clapping his hands in a precise, even rhythm, face serious; warm reflected light from the stage lighting him from below, the dark seated audience around him

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: island villagers jumping up from their seats in the back, grandma Sunrye springing to her feet shouting with her mouth wide. Bottom: from behind Eunju on stage, bow still raised, the whole audience rising in a wave from the front rows to the back, a small child and its mother standing in the third row, applause filling the hall, warm light

tall panel split into three frames. Top: Mr. Choi half risen in the back corner, pressing his handkerchief over his whole face. Middle: extreme close-up of Manseok's long hands gripping the back of the seat in front of him hard, not clapping. Bottom: match cut flashback, the same hands at the same size and angle gripping the wooden handles of an old handcart outdoors, daylight

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: wide frontal shot of the stage, the school ensembles lined up side by side, the uniformed players in black standing neat and straight, the island children crooked and uneven hugging their scrap instruments, the MC at right tearing open an envelope at the microphone. Bottom: extreme close-up of Seonyoung's hand gripping Eunju's hand, Seonyoung's trembling more

tall panel split into three frames. Top: close-up of Dongmin nervously drumming on his own knee with two wooden spoon drumsticks. Middle: close-up of the MC's mouth at the microphone, mid-word. Bottom: the island villagers at the back of the hall all leaping up at once with raised arms and open mouths, a roar of joy, warm light

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: Mija thrusting her drainpipe trumpet high overhead and shouting triumphantly, Deoksu beside her hugging the oil-drum cello with a sleepy deadpan face. Bottom: the twins clashing pot lids together, a flustered stage staffer hurrying over, and Seonyoung crying and laughing at once, her round glasses fogged white as she pushes them up

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: point-of-view shot from Eunju on the bright stage looking into the shadow of the curtain at the wing, old Kwak standing there unsmiling, a yellow work lamp behind him. Bottom: close-up of his hand with the bent ring and little fingers raising one thumb up, nothing more

tall panel split into two frames, slow push-in with the same composition, frontal. Top: bust shot of Eunju turning from the wing, her face beginning to loosen. Bottom: close-up, Eunju smiling fully for the first time, eyes crinkled into crescents, teeth showing, her whole face opened up, almost surprised at herself. Warm amber stage light from above, background soft

medium shot, high angle: Dongmin looking up at his sister with his mouth hanging open in astonishment, the gap of his missing front tooth showing, eyes round; Eunju's smiling face at the top edge of the frame, out of focus, warm stage light

medium shot over Eunju's shoulder in a crowded lobby with a terrazzo floor, low late-afternoon sun backlighting through the tall glass doors, bouquets and a bursting camera flash; island children passing a certificate around chattering in the background; Taejun approaching through the crowd carrying his violin case, calm face

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: extreme close-up of the new E string on the tin-can violin catching the low sunlight, the only string that shines. Bottom: two-shot, Taejun lifting his eyes from the violin to Eunju and speaking, Eunju answering briefly with only the corners of her mouth moving, warm backlight

two-shot, side view: Taejun on the right rubbing his eyes, then pausing a half beat before speaking; Eunju on the left tilting her head to the left, then nodding; people blurred behind them, low warm sunlight from the glass doors

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: Taejun turning away as he speaks, a faint ease in his face. Bottom: extreme close-up of his fingertips around the handle of the violin case as he walks off, framed at exactly the same size as the earlier trembling fingertips on stage, now perfectly steady

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high angle from the top of the stone steps at sunset, Manseok standing at the bottom with the low sun behind him, his long shadow stretching up the steps, Eunju descending toward him hugging the tin-can violin. Bottom: insert inside his jacket pocket, fingers closing on a folded worn pawn ticket and letting go

close-up, low angle: Manseok speaking quietly after a long silence, half of his gaunt face in shadow against orange-gold backlight from the setting sun, eyes resting just above Eunju's head, mouth barely moving, one hand still in the pocket of his field jacket, the stone steps and plaza glowing behind him

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: close-up, high angle, Eunju looking up after a half-beat pause, only the corners of her mouth lifting. Bottom: Manseok laughing silently, only his shoulders shaking, his long fingers resting on the top of her head over the rubber-band-tied hair, Eunju keeping her head lowered and still; orange sunset light

tall panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: Manseok pulling his hand back gruffly, looking away. Bottom: wide shot of the plaza in the sunset, grandma Sunrye waving a ladle in front of the old charter bus, villagers cheering, Mija tugging the sleeve of hesitant Mr. Choi clutching an envelope and handkerchief at the bus door, Manseok and Eunju walking side by side toward the bus

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: static wide shot at sunset, the old charter bus crossing the embankment road toward the island, the two trash hills silhouetted, evening smoke rising over shack roofs, orange to violet sky. Bottom: through the bus window, Eunju resting her forehead against the glass looking at the island, Dongmin asleep on her shoulder, the tin-can violin on her lap

static wide shot, eye level, same composition as the embankment view: the tiny charter bus shrinking along the embankment road toward the island at sunset, the two flat-topped trash hills dark against an orange and violet sky, reeds along the water, quiet composition, empty negative space

static wide shot, eye level, exactly the same composition as the previous embankment view, now in bright spring daylight: a broad walking path where the embankment road was, two hills across the river completely green with grass and wildflowers, a clear blue sky for the first time, a banner on the hillside with unreadable blank columns suggesting text

tall montage split into four frames. 1: autumn 1988, loaded moving trucks driving in a line out along the embankment road. 2: a dirt alley of identical prefabricated temporary houses, families unpacking, grandma Sunrye waving at a neighbor's window, Mr. Choi at the alley entrance ticking names on a list with unreadable blank strokes suggesting text while wiping sweat. 3: 1990, the same faces at the windows of a new low-rise rental apartment block. 4: Dongmin, Deoksu and other island kids running together through a school gate

tall panel split into four frames, the same static wide composition from the mainland end of the embankment, seasons passing quickly. 1: the empty island under a cloudy gray-brown sky, shacks torn down, no people. 2: years later, earth-moving machines spreading fresh soil over the trash hills. 3: first green sprouts on the bare soil. 4: the two hills fully green under a bright spring sky

panel split horizontally into two frames, yellowish fluorescent light. Top: high angle over an old pawnshop counter, island children crowding in through the door, Mija at the front turning a tin can upside down, generic coins with no real currency design pouring out across the counter. Bottom: two dusty instrument cases, a clarinet case and a violin case, set side by side, dust being blown off them

outfit.eunju: a simple deep-navy long concert dress
outfit.manseok: a pressed white shirt and black trousers, no cap, white hair

char_text.eunju: Eunju as an adult Korean woman of about 28, slim, adult proportions, sun-tanned skin, narrow face, large long almond-shaped eyes, thick straight eyebrows, no bangs with the forehead visible, loose wisps of hair at both temples, faint freckles, long dark-brown hair tied low at the nape with a single rubber band, a small silver tuning-fork pendant on a thin chain, tilts her head slightly to the left when listening
char_text.manseok: Manseok, Korean man in his mid-50s, 170cm, gaunt and slightly stooped, long gaunt face, hollow cheeks, clean-shaven, short fully white hair, no cap, long fingers

cut_en: wide establishing shot from behind the folding-chair audience, wide spring sky: a small wooden stage on the green hilltop, the river sparkling far below; Eunju, now an adult woman of about 28, stepping onto the stage with her long hair still tied low with one rubber band; Manseok, now in his mid-fifties with white hair and no cap, beside her; a banner with unreadable blank columns suggesting text

outfit.eunju: a simple deep-navy long concert dress
outfit.manseok: a pressed white shirt and black trousers, no cap, white hair

char_text.eunju: Eunju as an adult Korean woman of about 28, slim, adult proportions, sun-tanned skin, narrow face, large long almond-shaped eyes, thick straight eyebrows, no bangs with the forehead visible, loose wisps of hair at both temples, faint freckles, long dark-brown hair tied low at the nape with a single rubber band, a small silver tuning-fork pendant on a thin chain, tilts her head slightly to the left when listening
char_text.manseok: Manseok, Korean man in his mid-50s, 170cm, gaunt and slightly stooped, long gaunt face, hollow cheeks, clean-shaven, short fully white hair, no cap, long fingers

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames, bright spring daylight. Top: extreme close-up of the dented tin-can violin in adult Eunju's hands, its wooden-spoon neck darkened by years of handling, the silver tuning fork at her collarbone, behind it a real violin case on a stand covered with old luggage tags. Bottom: white-haired Manseok, in his mid-fifties, holding a clarinet with new pads and polished keys; an old broken transistor radio on a chair

outfit.kwak: a clean brown cardigan over a shirt

char_text.kwak: old Kwak, Korean man in his early 80s, 160cm, short and solidly built with a perfectly upright posture (not stooped), square jaw, short white buzz cut, short thick white eyebrows, deep wrinkles, reading glasses pushed up on his forehead, a pencil behind his ear, ring and little finger of the right hand permanently bent
char_text.seonyoung: Seonyoung, Korean woman in her late 30s, 162cm, slim, round face, neat shoulder-length softly waved hair, large round thin gold-rim glasses

cut_en: point-of-view shot from Eunju on stage, panning along the front row: old Kwak, now in his eighties, still sitting perfectly upright with a pencil behind his ear, eyes on the clarinet keys, nodding once without a smile; beside him Seonyoung, now in her late thirties, pushing up her round glasses as uniformed middle-school students wave at her from a back row. Bright spring light

outfit.mija: a slim-fit 2003-style navy tracksuit with side stripes, no logo, a whistle around the neck, an attendance book under the arm
outfit.deoksu: a flower-pattern apron over work clothes
outfit.dongmin: a plain black T-shirt and straight-leg jeans

char_text.mija: Mija as an adult Korean woman of about 29, tall with broad shoulders, short practical bob, thick eyebrows, square jaw, a confident grin
char_text.deoksu: Deoksu as an adult Korean man of about 27, big and chubby, round face, short crew cut (no fade), droopy gentle eyes
char_text.dongmin: Dongmin as a young Korean man of about 24, round face, short neat hair, big ears, a full set of adult teeth

cut_en: point-of-view shot from the stage, the pan continuing along the audience: Mija, now a woman of about 29, sprawling both arms over the empty chair beside her; Deoksu, now about 27, a big pot on his knees with steam escaping under the lid; Dongmin, now a young man of about 24, drumsticks on his knee, fingers tapping a precise beat. Bright spring daylight

outfit.eunju: a simple deep-navy long concert dress
outfit.choi: a gray suit without a tie
outfit.sunrye: a purple going-out blouse and a long plain dark skirt

char_text.taejun: Taejun as an adult Korean man of about 29, tall and slim, long face, narrow long eyes, neat 7:3 side part with the forehead visible, thin lips, pale skin, very straight posture
char_text.eunju: Eunju as an adult Korean woman of about 28, slim, adult proportions, sun-tanned skin, narrow face, large long almond-shaped eyes, thick straight eyebrows, no bangs with the forehead visible, loose wisps of hair at both temples, faint freckles, long dark-brown hair tied low at the nape with a single rubber band, a small silver tuning-fork pendant on a thin chain, tilts her head slightly to the left when listening
char_text.choi: Mr. Choi, retired Korean civil servant of about 61, medium height with a slight belly, graying pomaded 7:3 side part, thick black horn-rimmed glasses, a sheen of sweat on the forehead, a white handkerchief in hand
char_text.sunrye: grandma Sunrye, Korean woman in her late 80s, very small and more deeply stooped, white hair pulled back into a low traditional bun fixed with a single plain binyeo hairpin, deep wrinkles

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: cutback between audience and stage, Taejun, now about 29, arms crossed, frowning and pointing a finger upward; adult Eunju shaking her head and pointing a finger down. Bottom: retired Mr. Choi, now about 61, already clutching his handkerchief; grandma Sunrye, now in her late eighties and more stooped, speaking without turning around while kids chatter behind her

outfit.eunju: a simple deep-navy long concert dress
outfit.manseok: a pressed white shirt and black trousers, no cap, white hair

char_text.eunju: Eunju as an adult Korean woman of about 28, slim, adult proportions, sun-tanned skin, narrow face, large long almond-shaped eyes, thick straight eyebrows, no bangs with the forehead visible, loose wisps of hair at both temples, faint freckles, long dark-brown hair tied low at the nape with a single rubber band, a small silver tuning-fork pendant on a thin chain, tilts her head slightly to the left when listening
char_text.manseok: Manseok, Korean man in his mid-50s, 170cm, gaunt and slightly stooped, long gaunt face, hollow cheeks, clean-shaven, short fully white hair, no cap, long fingers

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames, natural colors, no glowing effects. Top: two-shot, adult Eunju flicking the silver tuning fork while white-haired Manseok, in his mid-fifties, answers the same note on his clarinet. Bottom: the two playing a duet, Eunju on the tin-can violin waiting a half beat for her father, her eyes glancing once at the old radio on the chair. Bright spring sunlight

long shot, high angle moving down the grassy hillside: spring grass and wildflowers over dark soil, the river sparkling at the bottom of the slope under a clear sky, the ground quiet and peaceful as if the old island lies somewhere beneath it, natural colors, empty negative space in the sky

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: close-up of many audience hands raised, palms about to meet for applause, frozen just before touching. Bottom: extreme close-up of the old broken transistor radio on a folding chair, thin soft lavender rings spreading from its speaker grille. Keep the whole frame in full bright natural spring color, not desaturated

outfit.manseok: a pressed white shirt and black trousers, no cap, white hair
outfit.kwak: a clean brown cardigan over a shirt
outfit.dongmin: a plain black T-shirt and straight-leg jeans

char_text.manseok: Manseok, Korean man in his mid-50s, 170cm, gaunt and slightly stooped, long gaunt face, hollow cheeks, clean-shaven, short fully white hair, no cap, long fingers
char_text.kwak: old Kwak, Korean man in his early 80s, 160cm, short and solidly built with a perfectly upright posture (not stooped), square jaw, short white buzz cut, short thick white eyebrows, deep wrinkles, reading glasses pushed up on his forehead, a pencil behind his ear, ring and little finger of the right hand permanently bent
char_text.dongmin: Dongmin as a young Korean man of about 24, round face, short neat hair, big ears, a full set of adult teeth

cut_en: tall panel split into three frames. Top: white-haired Manseok slowly lowering his clarinet, and old Kwak in the front row tilting his head to the left. Middle: silent flashback in navy night light: the same Dongmin as a nine-year-old boy, not the adult: round face, very short clipper buzz cut, upper-left front tooth missing, big ears, wrapped in a blanket in a tiny shack room, looking up and mouthing a question. Bottom: close-up of Dongmin as a young man of about 24 (the adult look applies to this frame only) in the audience, nodding slowly

outfit.eunju: a simple deep-navy long concert dress

char_text.eunju: Eunju as an adult Korean woman of about 28, slim, adult proportions, sun-tanned skin, narrow face, large long almond-shaped eyes, thick straight eyebrows, no bangs with the forehead visible, loose wisps of hair at both temples, faint freckles, long dark-brown hair tied low at the nape with a single rubber band, a small silver tuning-fork pendant on a thin chain, tilts her head slightly to the left when listening

cut_en: close-up, frontal: Eunju as an adult woman of about 28 smiling broadly, eyes crinkled into crescents, teeth showing, her whole face open and bright; behind her the green hilltop and a wide clear spring sky, soft natural sunlight from above, full natural color, quiet composition
